Name: Antisocial Pierre
Author: ChaosApple0731
Description: Do you hate Pierre and are a Joja member? Wish you weren't forced to befriend him to acheive true perfection? Now you don't have to! With this mod, if you are a Joja member, Pierre will disappear from your social tab. The first in a series. Stay tuned for an upoming mod that will expand upon this by making Pierre hate you if you are a Joja member.

Manifest.Name: Antisocial Pierre
Manifest.Description: Turns Pierre into a antisocial NPC if you're a Joja member.
